triples.tail_surface: Check to see that this grease fitting is present and that the stuffing box is properly lubricated with grease
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查油脂嘴存在及填料箱润滑状态
triples.evidence_text: Check to see that this grease fitting is present and that the stuffing box is properly lubricated with grease.

triples.tail_surface: remove the grease fitting and install automatic lubricator and/or lubrication line
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆除油脂嘴并安装自动润滑器或润滑管线
triples.evidence_text: If lubrication of the stuffing box is to be accomplished by means other than a grease gun, remove the grease fitting and install automatic lubricator and/or lubrication line as dictated by the job requirements.

triples.tail_surface: fresh cool water from an outside source should be piped to the stuffing box at a pressure about one atmosphere higher than maximum discharge pressure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 引入外部冷却水并保持压力高于最大排出压力约一个大气压
triples.evidence_text: If the liquid being pumped is not suitable for stuffing box lubrication, fresh cool water from an outside source should be piped to the stuffing box at a pressure about one atmosphere higher than maximum discharge pressure.

triples.tail_surface: Water lubrication is required through this line
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过该管线进行水润滑
triples.evidence_text: Water lubrication is required through this line for pumps having either water or grease lubricated stuffing boxes.
